summary: B1 isolated CI+Host read-only evidence gates and local single-writer flock; Host needs independent signed LFL snapshot, approved main policy and verified branch protection before merge eligibility.

components.owning_subsystem: GitHub Actions CI evidence job, separate read-only Host GitHub API verifier and narrow local integration-writer flock
components.disposition: ADMIT isolated B1 code and negative tests only. Host never merges or pushes; no production activation, no branch protection changes and no automatic remote main CAS.
evidence: B1-1 CI evidence job and 13 initial tests were developed in LFL Web with glm/glm-5.3-flash; later Host/lock code and tests were authored by the coordinating developer.

Host verifier requires a fresh HMAC-signed local snapshot, GitHub API branch protection, exact context+app_id policy from protected main, push/PR check-run provenance, Actions run and artifact, and gate blob equality against independent main; unknown facts HOLD.

CI artifact includes read-only Git blob hashes for three gate files; Host cross-checks candidate and trusted main blobs. Gate-changing PRs cannot self-approve and require a separate bootstrap/upgrade process.
Local integration tool holds an OS flock under real git-common-dir and only cherry-picks exact commits into a clean non-main worktree; it never pushes or deploys.

Remote GitHub main protection required_status_checks returned 404 Branch not protected and rulesets=[] at implementation time; Host eligibility is therefore BLOCKED until a separately authorized bootstrap and protected policy installation.
components.verification_level: Focused CI/Host/flock tests and Ruff/YAML/A.5 to be verified on final SHA; independent code Reviewer, original full R9, remote PR CI and branch protection are pending.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Any 403/404, missing signed Host snapshot, stale Lane/Queue version, failed reviewer/R9, PR run mismatch, skipped/RED required check, untrusted gate/policy blob, or lock contention must HOLD with no merge side effect.
components.rollback_route: Revert isolated B1 PR or disable the CI evidence job; no durable migration or production changes. Dirty integration worktrees are retained for owner reconciliation.

components.disposition: Document exact changed paths and truthful verification status without adding runtime authority.
evidence: A.5 declaration includes itself and exactly seven B1 implementation/test/workflow paths.
components.verification_level: A.5 exact changed-path coverage must pass on final SHA; independent Reviewer, original full R9 and remote CI are pending.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: If coverage or declaration is inaccurate, correct in the isolated branch and re-run A.5; never claim unperformed review/R9/CI as complete.
components.rollback_route: Revert the isolated PR; no runtime state impact.

g1.necessity: B1 needs a machine-consumed CI sibling evidence job, independent Host verification of required GitHub rules/check runs and trusted gate blobs, and a single local integration writer to avoid two simultaneous cherry-picks.

g2.authority_owner: GitHub API owns branch protection, check-runs and Actions evidence; existing LFL Lane/Queue/Reviewer/R9 stores remain authoritative. The Host verifies a fresh signed snapshot issued by a separately trusted Host. Git common dir OS flock serializes only the narrow local integration tool.
g2.non_duplication: Reuse existing CI workflow and four siblings; no new Goal/Lane ledger, no new approval authority, no generic shell executor and no atomic remote main CAS. The signed Host snapshot issuer is not yet wired to the production managed Host.

model_evidence: CI/Host/flock synthetic positive and negative tests cover forged run IDs, app_id mismatches, PR-only checks, policy self-upgrades, branch protection absence, main advance and two-process lock contention.
CI artifact Git blob binding and Host second-read main/PR race rejection are exercised in unit tests.
No live Host eligibility PASS is claimed: remote main branch protection returned 404; independent trusted policy and snapshot issuer are not yet deployed.
g3.recovery_or_reason: Return HOLD for missing/ambiguous evidence, reject same-PR gate changes against trusted main, retain dirty integration tree and require operator-led reconciliation; do not auto-retry side effects.

g4.rollback: Revert isolated B1 PR to remove CI/Host/local integration tool; no persistent data schema changes or live deployment.
verification: Run all focused tests, Ruff, A.5 exact path coverage and original full R9 on final frozen candidate.
Independent Reviewer PASS P0/P1=0, exact SHA PR CI and branch protection/rules policy verification are required before managed main merge.
Bootstrap of the new required context and signed Host snapshot issuer require independent operator authorization and verified production wiring; no self-approval.
